description:
Validate up to 200 emails in one request.
When to use: When the user has a small list to validate in one shot (not a CSV upload).
Parameters: emails — array of addresses (or CSV rows with emailAddressColumn); optional timeout (10-120), activityData, verifyPlus.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

activityData.description: Include activity data on each validation result

emailAddressColumn.description: Optional 0-based column index when each entry is a CSV row; the email is read from that column. Omit when entries are plain email addresses.

emails.description: Array of email addresses to validate (at most 200)

verifyPlus.description: Use Verify+ validation for this batch

name: validate_batch
title: Validate email list
